classes.name: GroundOperationsPartner
classes.definition: The Aircraft Operator or Ground Handler, referred to jointly as AO/GH, who manages the turn-round process and provides the flight's operational time estimates.

attributes.name: partnerId
attributes.description: Identifies the Aircraft Operator or Ground Handler acting as AO/GH.

operations.name: provideTobt
operations.description: AO/GH provide TOBT, updated automatically or inserted manually, calculated on the basis of the defined/estimated turn-round period for the departing flight (milestones 4,6,7,8).

operations.name: confirmFinalTobt
operations.description: AO/GH provide their most accurate TOBT, taking into account the operational situation, t minutes before EOBT (milestone 9).

operations.name: manageTurnRound
operations.description: AO/GH, in coordination with the aircrew, manage the turn-round process accordingly once TOBT/TSAT is established (milestones 9,10).

operations.name: provideReadyStatus
operations.description: AO/GH provide Actual Ready Time (ARDT) confirming that all doors are closed, boarding bridge removed, push back vehicle connected, ready to taxi (milestone 12).

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline that operates the flight and submits the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: submitAtcFlightPlan
operations.description: The ATC Flight Plan is submitted by the Aircraft Operator and distributed by the IFPS (milestone 1).

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The party that performs ground handling operations for the flight, jointly with the Aircraft Operator referred to as AO/GH.

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The party (Network Manager operations) that issues CTOT, monitors regulated flights, and receives DPI and update messages from the airport.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifies Network Operations.

operations.name: issueCtot
operations.description: CTOT is issued by Network Operations at EOBT-2hr for regulated flights and sent to relevant ATS units and the departure aerodrome; CTOT flights usually have priority over unregulated flights (milestone 2).

operations.name: monitorFlightProgress
operations.description: Network Operations monitors progress of the flight using the ETFMS and sends a Flight Update Message when the flight is within 3hrs flying time of the destination (milestone 3).

operations.name: receiveDpiMessage
operations.description: Network Operations receives DPI messages from the Airport CDM Platform (milestones 1,2,3,10,15).

classes.name: ATCUnit
classes.definition: The air traffic control unit(s), including the departure aerodrome's ATC, that receive the ATC Flight Plan and issue TSAT and start-up approval.

attributes.name: unitName
attributes.description: Identifies the ATC unit.

operations.name: receiveFlightPlan
operations.description: All involved ATC units receive the flight plan, including departure and destination aerodromes (milestone 1).

classes.name: FlightCrew
classes.definition: The pilot and aircrew who request start-up and operate the aircraft during the turn-round.

operations.name: requestStartUp
operations.description: The pilot requests start up just before TSAT, following coordination with the Ground Handler, by voice or DCL (milestones 12,14).

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: An arriving or departing flight leg of a turn-round, tracked through the milestones with its operational status and time quantities.

attributes.name: flightId
attributes.description: Identifies the flight.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Whether the flight is the arrival or departure leg of the aircraft turn-round.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The flight's current operational status, changed at each milestone.

attributes.name: regulated
attributes.description: True once the flight has received a CTOT and its fields are marked REGULATED; regulated flights usually have priority over unregulated flights (milestone 2).

attributes.name: offBlockTime
attributes.description: The flight's SOBT/EOBT/TOBT/AOBT history.

attributes.name: inBlockTime
attributes.description: The flight's EIBT/AIBT history.

attributes.name: landingTime
attributes.description: The flight's ELDT/ALDT history.

attributes.name: takeOffTime
attributes.description: The flight's ETOT/TTOT/CTOT/ATOT history.

attributes.name: taxiOutTime
attributes.description: The flight's EXOT.

attributes.name: taxiInTime
attributes.description: The flight's EXIT.

attributes.name: turnroundTimeEstimate
attributes.description: The estimated/minimum turn-round period (MTTT) used to calculate TOBT and TTOT.

attributes.name: groundHandlingTime
attributes.description: The flight's ACGT.

attributes.name: boardingTime
attributes.description: The flight's ASBT.

attributes.name: readyTime
attributes.description: The flight's ARDT.

attributes.name: startUpRequestTime
attributes.description: The flight's ASRT.

attributes.name: startUpApprovalTime
attributes.description: The flight's TSAT/ASAT.

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The aircraft turn-round that normally includes an arriving and a departing flight, each with a related flight plan.

attributes.name: turnRoundId
attributes.description: Identifies the aircraft turn-round.

classes.name: Aircraft
classes.definition: The physical aircraft that operates a flight, identified by registration and type.

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: The aircraft's registration.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The aircraft type, which the flight plan may be used to update.

operations.name: updateType
operations.description: The flight plan may be used to update certain information such as type of aircraft (milestone 1).

classes.name: AtcFlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO flight plan submitted to ATC for a flight, distributed by the IFPS to involved ATC units.

attributes.name: sobt
attributes.description: The Scheduled Off-Block Time, part of the consistent information the AO must provide before the first E-DPI.

attributes.name: departureAerodrome
attributes.description: The departure aerodrome named in the flight plan.

attributes.name: destinationAerodrome
attributes.description: The destination aerodrome named in the flight plan.

attributes.name: aircraftRegistration
attributes.description: The aircraft registration fed to Network Operations, which must be consistent before the first E-DPI.

attributes.name: isRepetitive
attributes.description: True if this is a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights.

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot programme entry that the ATC Flight Plan must correspond to.

attributes.name: slotProgrammeReference
attributes.description: Reference to the airport slot programme entry.

attributes.name: scheduledTime
attributes.description: The slot's scheduled time, which for long distance flights may differ from ELDT.

classes.name: AirportFlightData
classes.definition: The airport's own flight data record, checked for consistency with the ATC Flight Plan and Airport Slot, and used to initiate the outbound flight at non-coordinated airports.

attributes.name: dataReference
attributes.description: Reference to the airport's own flight data record.

classes.name: TimeQuantity
classes.definition: An abstract time quantity describing a flight's progress, whose successive scheduled, estimated, target, actual, or calculated values are all kept rather than overwritten.

attributes.name: values
attributes.description: Every successive value recorded for this time quantity, kept so a turn-round can be analysed afterwards; an update appends rather than overwrites.

operations.name: appendValue
operations.description: Records a new value of this time quantity with its originator and time of update; an update appends rather than overwrites.

classes.name: TimeValue
classes.definition: One recorded value of a time quantity, with the prefix that identifies its kind, its originator, and its accuracy.

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Whether this is the scheduled, estimated, target, actual, or calculated value.

attributes.name: dateTime
attributes.description: The value of the time quantity.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: Who provided or calculated this value, e.g. ATC, AO/GH, ACARS, Network Operations.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The stated accuracy of this value, e.g. +/-1 minute for actual times.

attributes.name: timeOfUpdate
attributes.description: When this value was recorded.

classes.name: OffBlockTime
classes.definition: The event of the aircraft leaving the parking position, kept as SOBT, EOBT, TOBT and AOBT values.

attributes.name: tobtUpdateThreshold
attributes.description: The locally defined threshold for the number of TOBT updates allowed after TSAT has been issued (milestone 10).

classes.name: InBlockTime
classes.definition: The event of the aircraft arriving in-blocks, kept as EIBT and AIBT values.

classes.name: LandingTime
classes.definition: The event of the aircraft touching down, kept as ELDT and ALDT values.

classes.name: TakeOffTime
classes.definition: The event of the aircraft taking off, kept as ETOT, TTOT, CTOT, and ATOT values.

attributes.name: ttotTolerance
attributes.description: The TTOT tolerance (e.g. 5 minutes at take off from outstation) that must be exceeded before Network Operations is informed of an updated TTOT.

classes.name: StartUpApprovalTime
classes.definition: The event of the aircraft's start-up approval, kept as TSAT and ASAT values.

attributes.name: tsatTolerance
attributes.description: The locally agreed TSAT tolerance window within which start-up must be requested and approved.

classes.name: TaxiOutTime
classes.definition: The Estimated Taxi-Out Time (EXOT), calculated by the ATC system based on predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the Holding Position.

classes.name: TaxiInTime
classes.definition: The Estimated Taxi-In Time (EXIT), used with ELDT to compute EIBT.

classes.name: TurnroundTime
classes.definition: The estimated or minimum turn-round period (MTTT) used as basis for TOBT and TTOT calculation.

attributes.name: minimumTurnRoundTime
attributes.description: MTTT, the minimum/estimated turn-round period used in the TTOT calculation basis EIBT+MTTT+EXOT.

classes.name: GroundHandlingTime
classes.definition: The Actual Commencement of Ground Handling Time (ACGT), specific to first-of-day or long-parked flights.

classes.name: BoardingTime
classes.definition: The Actual Start Boarding Time (ASBT), when the gate opens for passengers to physically start boarding.

attributes.name: boardingCheckOffset
attributes.description: A locally defined time before TOBT (e.g. corresponding to aircraft type) at which boarding status is checked.

classes.name: ReadyTime
classes.definition: The Actual Ready Time (ARDT), when all doors are closed, boarding bridge removed, push back vehicle connected.

attributes.name: readyTolerance
attributes.description: TOBT + tolerance, after which AO/GH are informed that no ready status has been received.

classes.name: StartUpRequestTime
classes.definition: The Actual Start-up Request Time (ASRT), when start-up is requested by the pilot.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.definition: An abstract CDM process event with its trigger, timing rule, effect, procedure, and the flight status it produces.

attributes.name: milestoneName
attributes.description: The name of the milestone.

attributes.name: definition
attributes.description: The milestone's definition as stated in the document.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: What triggers this milestone's process.

attributes.name: timingRule
attributes.description: When this milestone's process takes place.

attributes.name: effect
attributes.description: The effect this milestone has on flight data and downstream decisions.

attributes.name: newStatus
attributes.description: The operational status the flight changes to at this milestone; not applicable for some milestones.

operations.name: applyStatusChange
operations.description: Changes the flight's operational status to newStatus on occurrence of this milestone.

classes.name: FlightPlanActivated
classes.definition: Milestone 1: the ICAO flight plan is submitted to ATC and the Airport CDM Platform is initiated for the flight.

operations.name: checkFlightPlanConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot, and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent.

operations.name: confirmFlightToNetworkOperations
operations.description: Confirms the flight to Network Operations and allows further local processing of the flight.

operations.name: sendFirstEdpi
operations.description: Sends the first E-DPI message with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration and first destination data once the AO has provided correct information; the E-DPI should not be sent if no or inconsistent information is provided. Triggered by first activation of the ATC Flight Plan (earliest EOBT-3hr), or new/late submissions after cancellation or revised EOBT.

classes.name: RegulationCheck
classes.definition: Milestone 2 (EOBT-2hr): most flights are known in the Airport CDM Platform and regulated flights receive a CTOT from Network Operations.

operations.name: checkFlightEstimatesConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, to verify feasibility of the estimated off block time at EOBT-2hrs.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsOfTtot
operations.description: Informs Network Operations about the updated take off time estimate using a T-DPI message at EOBT-2hrs.

operations.name: calculateTtot
operations.description: Calculation basis for TTOT is EIBT+MTTT+EXOT, if later than EOBT+EXOT. In case of manual TOBT input, this overrides the EIBT+MTTT estimate, hence TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT.

classes.name: TakeOffFromOutstation
classes.definition: Milestone 3: the ATOT from the outstation (ADEP) is provided to Network Operations and the Aircraft Operator.

operations.name: checkLandingEstimateConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH estimated landing time after take off from outstation is consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsTdpiT
operations.description: Informs Network Operations of updated take off time estimates using a T-DPI-t message when needed; a TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes is respected before informing.

operations.name: calculateTtot
operations.description: Calculation basis for TTOT is EIBT+MTTT+EXOT. If EOBT is later than EIBT+MTTT, TTOT equals EOBT+EXOT. If TOBT is available it overrules the EIBT+MTTT estimate, so TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT.

classes.name: LocalRadarUpdate
classes.definition: Milestone 4: the flight enters the FIR or local airspace of the destination airport, detected by radar based on SSR code.

operations.name: commenceTobtProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process on detection of the flight by radar in FIR, TMA, or on Final Approach.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotExceedsTolerance
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: FinalApproach
classes.definition: Milestone 5: the flight enters the Final Approach phase at the destination airport, typically 2 to 5 minutes from landing.

operations.name: commenceTobtProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process on detection of the flight on Final Approach.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotExceedsTolerance
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: Landed
classes.definition: Milestone 6: ALDT, the time the aircraft touches down on the runway.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan, triggered by Actual Landing Time (ALDT).

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotExceedsTolerance
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: InBlock
classes.definition: Milestone 7: AIBT, the time the aircraft arrives in-blocks.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan, triggered by Actual In Blocks Time (AIBT).

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotExceedsTolerance
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: GroundHandlingStarted
classes.definition: Milestone 8: ACGT, the commencement of ground handling operations, specific to first-of-day or long-parked flights.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan, triggered by Actual Commence of Ground Handling (ACGT).

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotExceedsTolerance
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: FinalTobtConfirmation
classes.definition: Milestone 9: the time at which the AO/GH provide their most accurate TOBT, t minutes before EOBT.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Performed at a predefined local time (t minutes before EOBT) to confirm TOBT prior to TSAT issue and verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan estimates.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotExceedsTolerance
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: TsatIssued
classes.definition: Milestone 10: the time ATC issues the Target Start Up Approval Time (TSAT).

operations.name: informPartnersOfTsat
operations.description: Informs all relevant partners of the TSAT allocated to the flight; Network Operations is informed by a T-DPI-s for non-regulated flights.

operations.name: checkTobtUpdateCount
operations.description: Checks whether the number of TOBT updates after TSAT has been issued exceeds a locally defined tolerance; if exceeded, TOBT input should be processed according to local procedure.

classes.name: BoardingStarts
classes.definition: Milestone 11: the gate is open for passengers to physically start boarding.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAsbt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start Boarding Time (ASBT) when it occurs.

operations.name: checkBoardingStatus
operations.description: At a locally defined time before TOBT, checks whether boarding starts in time to respect TOBT and informs the AO/GH in case TOBT needs to be updated.

classes.name: AircraftReady
classes.definition: Milestone 12: the time when all doors are closed, boarding bridge removed, push back vehicle connected, ready to taxi (ARDT).

operations.name: informPartnersOfArdt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Ready Time (ARDT) or Ready Status (RDY) that the aircraft is ready for start up/push-back.

operations.name: checkReadyStatusReceived
operations.description: At TOBT + tolerance, checks whether ARDT or Ready Status has been received and informs the AO/GH if TOBT has passed without it.

operations.name: refinePreDepartureSequence
operations.description: ATC refines the pre-departure sequence once the aircraft is ready.

classes.name: StartUpRequested
classes.definition: Milestone 13: the time that start up is requested (ASRT), based on pilot request.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAsrt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start up Request Time (ASRT) when it occurs.

operations.name: checkStartUpRequestedInTime
operations.description: Alerts all relevant Airport CDM Partners when no start-up has been requested inside the locally agreed TSAT tolerance window; if not requested by TSAT + tolerance the AO/GH is informed and should update TOBT.

classes.name: StartUpApproved
classes.definition: Milestone 14: ASAT, the time an aircraft receives its start-up approval.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAsat
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual start up approval Time (ASAT) and that the aircraft has received start up/push-back clearance.

operations.name: checkAsatAgainstTsat
operations.description: Checks if ASAT is in accordance with TSAT and alerts all relevant partners when no start-up has been granted at TSAT + tolerance; the flight will be re-sequenced.

classes.name: OffBlock
classes.definition: Milestone 15: AOBT, the time the aircraft pushes back/vacates the parking position.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAobt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Off-Block Time (AOBT) and that the aircraft has commenced push-back/taxi; AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations, or at a defined time prior to TTOT in case of remote holding.

operations.name: checkTtotChangeAgainstTolerance
operations.description: After the first A-DPI is sent, checks TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before Network Operations is informed, with a new A-DPI, of the updated TTOT.

classes.name: TakeOff
classes.definition: Milestone 16: ATOT, the time an aircraft takes off from the runway.

operations.name: informPartnersOfTakeOff
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners about the actual take off; an airborne message is generated and the flight is removed from the departure sequence. Triggered by Tower FDPS, A-SMGCS/Radar detection, or ACARS.

classes.name: AirportCDMPlatform
classes.definition: The Airport CDM Platform that is initiated per flight, processes all available flight information, and performs the CDM actions recorded at each milestone.

attributes.name: platformId
attributes.description: Identifies the CDM platform instance.

operations.name: initiatePlatform
operations.description: The Airport CDM Platform is initiated for this flight, and all available information is processed (milestone 1).

operations.name: updateArrivalEstimates
operations.description: ELDT and EIBT updated for an arrival (milestone 1).

operations.name: updateDepartureEstimates
operations.description: EOBT and ETOT updated for a departure (milestone 1).

operations.name: commenceDpiProcess
operations.description: The DPI process commences with Network Operations, if implemented (milestone 1).

operations.name: updateEtotTtotCtot
operations.description: ETOT/TTOT/CTOT updated (milestone 2).

operations.name: markRegulated
operations.description: Marks appropriate fields as REGULATED (milestone 2).

operations.name: updateEldtEibtTobtTtot
operations.description: ELDT, EIBT, TOBT and TTOT updated (milestones 3,4,5).

operations.name: updateAldtEibtTobtTtot
operations.description: ELDT changes to ALDT, EIBT, TOBT and TTOT updated (milestone 6).

operations.name: updateAibtTobtTtot
operations.description: EIBT changes to AIBT, TOBT and TTOT updated (milestone 7).

operations.name: updateEtttTobtTtot
operations.description: ETTT/TOBT, TTOT updated (milestone 8).

operations.name: evaluateTobtConfirmationNeeded
operations.description: Triggered by a new TOBT or TTOT update; no need to confirm an existing TOBT if it has been manually modified before (milestone 9).

operations.name: addToPreDepartureSequence
operations.description: The flight is introduced into the pre-departure sequence following receipt of TOBT (milestone 9).

operations.name: updateTtot
operations.description: TTOT updated (milestone 10).

operations.name: stabiliseInPreDepartureSequence
operations.description: The flight is stabilised into the pre-departure sequence once TSAT is issued (milestone 10).

operations.name: recordAobt
operations.description: AOBT recorded (milestone 15).

operations.name: recordAtot
operations.description: ATOT recorded (milestone 16).

classes.name: IFPS
classes.definition: The Integrated Initial Flight Plan Processing System that distributes the ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units.

operations.name: distributeFlightPlan
operations.description: Distributes the ATC Flight Plan so that all involved ATC units receive it, including departure and destination aerodromes.

classes.name: ETFMS
classes.definition: The system Network Operations uses to monitor the progress of a flight and generate Flight Update Messages.

operations.name: provideFlightUpdate
operations.description: Network Operations monitors progress of the flight using the ETFMS and sends a Flight Update Message (FUM) that provides updates of the flight's progress, when within 3hrs flying time of destination.

classes.name: ACARS
classes.definition: The aircraft communications addressing and reporting system that reports ON/OFF/IN/OUT times from equipped aircraft.

operations.name: reportTime
operations.description: ACARS equipped aircraft report times such as landing (ALDT, ACARS=ON), in-block (AIBT, ACARS=IN), off-block (AOBT, ACARS=OUT), and take-off (ATOT, ACARS=OFF).

classes.name: ATCSystem
classes.definition: The ATC/radar system (including A-SMGCS, Tower FDPS, and radar) that detects the flight and provides its actual times.

operations.name: detectFlight
operations.description: The radar system detects a flight based upon the assigned SSR code when it crosses a defined FIR/ATC boundary, range/position, or level (milestones 4,5).

operations.name: provideAtot
operations.description: Provides ATOT after take off from outstation (milestone 3).

operations.name: provideAldt
operations.description: Provides ALDT, the time an aircraft touches down (milestone 6).

operations.name: calculateExot
operations.description: Following receipt of TOBT, calculates and provides the Estimated Taxi-Out Time (EXOT) based on predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the Holding Position (milestone 9).

operations.name: detectTakeOff
operations.description: Detects take off, triggered by Tower FDPS, A-SMGCS/Radar detection or ACARS (milestone 16).

classes.name: DpiMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message sent by the Airport CDM Platform to Network Operations at various milestones.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The kind of DPI message: E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, or A-DPI.

attributes.name: sender
attributes.description: The sender of the message, the Airport CDM Platform.

attributes.name: ttotValue
attributes.description: The TTOT value carried by the message.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: When the message was sent.

classes.name: FlightUpdateMessage
classes.definition: The Flight Update Message (FUM) sent by Network Operations via the ETFMS to provide updates of a flight's progress.

attributes.name: eldtValue
attributes.description: The updated ELDT carried by the message.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: When the message was sent.

attributes.name: sender
attributes.description: The sender of the message, Network Operations.

classes.name: MovementMessage
classes.definition: The FSA or MVT movement message sent when a flight takes off.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Whether the message is an FSA or MVT message.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: When the message was generated.

packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display the process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.

unmodelled: Milestone 12 mentions the Dispatcher / Supervisor / Redcap as roles coordinating with the Ground Handler without further definition, so they could not be modelled as distinct classes.
Milestone 14 mentions start-up request by flight crew 'voice or DCL' without defining DCL, so it could not be modelled as a distinct message.
Milestone 1's DPI process messaging with Network Operations is deferred to 'attachment 2' and section 3.7.3, which are not part of this document and so could not be modelled in detail.
Milestone 8's Action on CDM Operation names 'ETTT' without defining it elsewhere in the document; it is only reflected via the general turn-round time attribute for lack of a clearer definition.
Milestone 9 states its process 'is actually constantly applicable in the CDM Platform, as soon as a TOBT is available,' a continuous-applicability rule that does not fit a single triggered operation.
